title: MPI II: collective communication and global numerical decisions
status: reviewed and locally validated; independent round 3 ACCEPT
transcript_provenance: Local machine transcription (faster-whisper small.en); not publisher captions
source_uncertainties: The installed default collective algorithms were not traced. Versioned Open MPI 4.1.6 source statements are conditional on that component and fixed policy being used; they are not inferred from timings.

All captures use TCP loopback plus self transport on one hybrid laptop, rather than shared-memory message transport or inter-node links. No measured latency/bandwidth fit or algorithm crossover is claimed.
The large trial variation is retained. Its allocation among scheduling, TCP processing and memory copies was not measured.
Historical parked-draft timing claims with incomplete raw evidence are excluded. Only the new retained captures supply empirical claims.
The lecture six-rank normalization program has an out-of-bounds gathered array. Arithmetic explains the visible partial values, but invalid C output is not promised or rerun.

The official MPI4.1 PDF prints collective chapter6, while the Forum explicitly unofficial HTML rendering uses chapter7. Inline HTML section labels identify that source format. A fresh local PDF download and PyMuPDF extraction checked title/version,printedpp189–190(chapter6/localcompletion),p196(barrier),pp250–252(nonblocking). Other routine details were checked through the individually linked HTML sections; the PDF did not confirm HTML chapter7 numbering. Programs use established pre4.1 APIs; large-count/persistent APIs are not demonstrated.

lecture_corrections.claim: Blocking broadcast waits for all receivers; collectives universally use fewer buffers; four broadcast pairs for four ranks.
lecture_corrections.correction: Completion is generally local; internal buffer allocation is not prescribed; a direct off-root schedule uses p-1 pairs.

lecture_corrections.claim: The fixed N=8 dot-product run at six ranks prints 182.
lecture_corrections.correction: Integer N/p includes the first six elements, giving twice the sum of their squares,182. The N/4 local allocation would overflow at p=1 or2. The new Scatterv program includes all eight elements.

lecture_corrections.claim: Allgather of all partial sums is needed for normalization; six-rank terminal output.
lecture_corrections.correction: An Allreduce of the combined scalar is sufficient. The fixed gathered_sums[4] overflows at six ranks and the integer partition omits the tail. The new program uses variable counts.
The receive vector is a correct transpose row, but the shown storage assignment writes original A_i,r back at position(i,r). The new block program transposes within received blocks.
The lecture states per-rank scaling to p*m bytes. Whole-job p^2*m result storage is the author-derived sum over replicas.
